steps.title: Stocks leaderboard
steps.narration: The stocks leaderboard shows all 122 universe members ranked by their composite score, with Leadership, Entry Quality, and Risk grades visible at a glance. This is the daily starting point for finding the best-positioned equities.
steps.point_out: NVDA appears with three numeric scores and a letter bucket (E), confirming the scoring engine is live and producing results.

steps.title: NVDA detail — explainable scores
steps.narration: Clicking any stock opens the detail page with a full breakdown of how each score was built — component by component — along with a price chart and an actionable invalidation level.
steps.point_out: The Leadership, Entry Quality, and Risk scores shown here are identical to the list page values (43.14 / 54.05 / 35.80), confirming a single source of truth with no recomputation.

steps.title: Data Manager — import and backfill
steps.narration: The Data Manager is where you grow the price history used for scoring. Start a live fetch job or run a backfill over existing seed data — both run asynchronously with a live progress counter.
steps.point_out: The page is fully interactive with no loading spinner. The import form and run history are both visible, showing the backend is healthy and responding.

steps.title: Rate-limited fetch — resumable checkpoint
steps.narration: When a live fetch hits a provider rate limit mid-run, the job pauses gracefully in an amber resumable state rather than failing. The exact chunk where it paused is saved, so resuming picks up exactly where the work stopped — no data is re-fetched or duplicated.
steps.point_out: The job card shows 'rate-limited — resumable' in amber with a message describing the saved checkpoint and a Resume button. The status is never 'failed'.
